source: Vanguard, How America Saves 2025: the single most common employer match formula among Vanguard-recordkept plans is 50% of the first 6% of pay. It is a mode, not a mean, and many plans use a different formula or none.
confidenceNote: A suggestion shown in Start Here, never stored until the person taps 'use this' (D-060). It exists so someone who knows they have 'a match' but not the numbers sees the most common shape rather than two empty boxes.
note: matchPercent is cents-on-the-dollar as a fraction (0.5 = 50 cents); matchCapPercentOfSalary is the share of salary matched (0.06 = the first 6%). The same units the household stores.
